summary: A LoadingBoundary around a suspending report with a fast (100 ms) and a slow (1.5 s) load button.
use: Showing a skeleton for slow data without flashing it on fast responses, in any page that awaits a loader.
spec: `{#key run}` restarts the load for each button
`ms = 100; run++;` is the fast case and `ms = 1500; run++;` the slow one
